name: Feedwater pump duty, NPSH and selection for package boilers
description: Maintain drum water level by delivering feedwater at flow above evaporation rate and at head above boiler pressure plus valve/piping losses; NPSH available must exceed pump NPSH required at hot feedwater temperature to avoid cavitation. Arrangements: direct feed per boiler or booster set feeding a common manifold with modulating feedwater valves.

specifications.basis: HPAC Engineering article by Steve Connor (Cleaver-Brooks) and Jim Swetye (Grundfos)
HPAC article step 2; 0.069 is a stated constant
specifications.value: boiler maximum-capacity HP x 0.069 x C; C=1.50 intermittent, C=1.15 continuous

specifications.basis: HPAC steps 3-4: continuous blowdown often ~10% of BEP flow; bypass recirculation often 10-20% of BEP flow
HPAC step 6; factor 1.03 is the safety margin on boiler pressure
specifications.value: max boiler operating pressure x 2.31 x 1.03 / liquid specific gravity

specifications.basis: HPAC steps 10 and 14; shutoff head must be at least 3% above safety-valve setting
HPAC step 12; NPSHr vs NPSHa must be checked for every installation (step 15)
specifications.value: absolute pressure in feedwater tank +/- elevation of minimum water level above pump - vapor pressure of water in tank - suction-line friction loss
